title: Computer Networking for Engineers
blurb: From bits on a wire to HTTP/3: layers, IP and routing, TCP, DNS, TLS, wireless, HTTP, browser performance, real-time APIs and backend networking, explained from zero with runnable simulations, annotated tool output and interview-style problems.
sources: MDN Web Docs (HTTP, Fetch, WebSocket, Performance APIs)

modules.summary: How networks are layered, why latency matters more than bandwidth, and the full journey of a web request.

What happens when you type a URL and press Enter
